verdicts.reason: A rebuilds the original's vertical stack well: the centred logo, a large can, headline, body copy and CTA read in the right order, and the brand and proportions are kept. Its flaws are small: the NEW FLAVOR badge sits cramped against the top-left corner, the body copy wraps leaving 'golden hour.' alone on the second line, and the bottom margin is tight. B shrinks the SOLSTICE logo to an illegible wordmark pushed into the top-right corner, which breaks the brand, and makes the can much smaller. Its oversized headline and nearly-as-large body copy crowd the lower half and blur the hierarchy, and the headline and body copy sit across the edge of the large background circle.
